question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Calamity
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4 i.e. Debacle'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Calamity" refers to a disaster or a situation causing extreme harm, loss, or distress.("आपत्ति"/ "विपत्ति")
 
• The word "Debacle" refers to a sudden and shocking failure or defeat, which is a synonym of calamity.("पराजय/"विफलता")

Therefore, the correct answer is- Option 4 (Debacle)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Embark" (आरंभ करना) means to start a journey or a project.
 
• "Debauchery" (चरित्रहीनता) refers to excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures.
 
• "Debar" (प्रतिबंधित करना) means to prohibit, ban, or bar from doing something.
